market_pack_unknown.why: GET/POST /api/simulation/commercial/market_packs/{pack_id}/... (SCU06 K8a) names a pack that does not exist (404). The assistant lists the packs from GET /api/simulation/commercial/market_packs.

market_pack_stale.why: POST /api/simulation/commercial/market_packs/{pack_id}/apply refuses a pack_hash that is not the pack's current one: the pack changed since the preview. The assistant previews again and shows the new changes before applying.

market_pack_zone_unknown.why: Market-pack preview/apply refuses when the project has no bidding zone (no zone pick and no site pin). The assistant points to the market-price card or the site pin.

market_pack_zone_mismatch.why: Market-pack preview/apply refuses a pack for another bidding zone than the project's. The assistant names both zones and offers the project's zone pack.

market_pack_currency_mismatch.why: Market-pack preview/apply refuses a pack whose currency is not the project's stated finance currency; nothing is converted. The assistant names both currencies.

market_pack_needs_connection.why: Market-pack preview/apply refuses while the project has no commercial config (no grid connection, poc_link). The assistant points to Commercial & parties to set the connection first.

market_pack_needs_saved_project.why: Market-pack apply refuses on an unsaved project: the pin of what the apply wrote lives in the project folder. The assistant asks the user to save the project first.

market_pack_pin_unreadable.why: Market-pack preview/apply refuses when market_pack.json cannot be read: what the last apply wrote is unknown, so user edits cannot be told apart. The assistant asks the user to restore or delete the file.

market_pack_currency_unknown.why: Market-pack preview/apply refuses when the project's finance inputs state no currency, so the pack's currency cannot be checked. The assistant asks the user to set the project's currency first.

market_pack_invalid.why: A stored market pack does not validate (an unknown bidding zone or another invalid field); it is refused with the field named, never a raw validation error. The assistant names the field.
